test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 9 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following numbers will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

4, 9, 20, 43, 90, ?
solution:
**Explanation:**

The pattern followed in the given series is:

 **The difference of the difference between the terms is twice of the previous.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a44f5fac3c9235bae6ea4f253a07d658b3c39abfc8a4e700648df6ffbcd5a0c5.png] 

**Hence the correct answer is option 4.**
